purpose: A route and component contract for making every GSE item readable, teachable, trustworthy, and action-oriented within 10 seconds.

required_layers.requirement: Use a human readable title, not an internal filename, API object, model key, or JSON label.
required_layers.acceptance: A new user can name what the item is without opening a tooltip.

required_layers.requirement: Summarize the item in one plain-English sentence.
required_layers.acceptance: The summary explains why the item matters now.

required_layers.requirement: Show freshness, risk, confidence, tier, source state, or availability badges when relevant.
required_layers.acceptance: The user can distinguish current, stale, risky, locked, and unavailable states visually and textually.

required_layers.requirement: Use a table, chart, comparison, timeline, ranked list, or scannable cards instead of raw JSON.
required_layers.acceptance: Raw JSON is hidden from normal users and only available behind founder/admin debug affordances.

required_layers.requirement: Attach a how-to drawer, tooltip, lesson link, motion explainer, or Galaxy Studios video where the item is proprietary or non-obvious.
required_layers.acceptance: The user can learn the item without leaving the page.

required_layers.requirement: Expose public-safe source freshness, receipt, or limitation context without revealing founder methodology.
required_layers.acceptance: The user knows how fresh the signal is and what not to overread.

required_layers.requirement: Provide one primary next action and optional secondary action.
required_layers.acceptance: The item never dead-ends unless it is an intentional legal/compliance block.
